info.name: VellumHub
info.description: Generated from service-owned OpenAPI contracts exposed by the gateway. Only `Cross-service workflows` is maintained manually.

item.name: Cross-service workflows
item.description: Manually maintained sequences for behavior that isolated OpenAPI operations do not express. Run this folder with the local environment selected. The default flow authenticates, captures a catalog book, reads the current user's ratings, and requests recommendations.

request.description: Authenticates with the User Service through the gateway and stores the returned JWT in `token`.

exec: pm.execution.setNextRequest("02 - List books and capture bookId");

request.description: Loads the first catalog page and stores the first book identifier in `bookId` for optional examples.

exec: pm.test("Catalog contains at least one book", function () { pm.expect(books.length).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Exercises the authenticated Engagement Service read path without mutating user state.
Requests personalized recommendations after exercising authenticated user, catalog, and engagement paths.
Optional state-changing example. Run manually after a `bookId` is captured. Re-running can conflict if the user already rated the same book.

exec: pm.test("Rating creation did not fail at the server layer", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500); });
